column2: and the build column is the ch_cfg.cpu value its rows run under: 0x1 is CH_CPU_PROBED alone
column3: and 0xe7 is every bit this CPU has that an object reads: CH_CPU_PROBED
sha384 and sha3_256 are -evp over -bytes; x25519_base and p256_ecdh_keygen are the key generations of X25519 and ECP-256
column4: which draw their random bytes; x25519 and p256_ecdh are ecdhx25519 and ecdhp256; p256_sign
column5: p256_ecdsa_verify and p384_ecdsa_verify are ecdsap256 and ecdsap384; the mlkem768 rows are ML-KEM-768; rsa_pkcs1_sign and rsa_pkcs1_verify are rsa2048 and rsa3072
column6: which sign and verify with PKCS#1 v1.5 padding
